content:
aisha: FYI found negative invoice adjustments after the route_tag schema flip. Looks like enrichment dropped tags for some events.

dan: can you share an example?

aisha: tenant t-4932, two sequential events:
``n{"event_id":"e-1001","route_tags":{"tier":"pro"},"tokens":120}
{"event_id":"e-1002","route_tags":null,"tokens":80}
```
second event lost route_tags -> default ratecard applied -> invoice delta.

kevin: probably the route_tag_v2 epoch shim. enrich falls back to null when it sees the old key. aggregator treats null as a separate bucket.

belinda: console preview also shows mismatched tallies vs ledger while both v1/v2 coexist. preview uses canonicalized tag, ledger uses enriched attr.

metering-bot: detected 1,432 events with missing route_tags in last 3h across 87 tenants.

kevin: recommend temporary aggregator compatibility: map null -> last_seen_tag per tenant-session for 12h, then run backfill.

aisha: +1. Backfill should reprocess enrichment window and write to replay topic with idempotency keys to avoid double-charges. Also alert on tag-drop rate >0.1%/tenant.

dan: who owns backfill runbook? risk of duplicates?

belinda: I'll own it. Runbook: attach consumer to metering.replay, enable idempotent writes on ledger producer, dry-run on dev, then prod.

kevin: I can add compatibility layer (10-15m) and help with deploy. Backfill estimate 30-45m depending on throughput.

deploy-bot: canary deploy aggregator-compat @ 1764567910 on 2 pods us-west.

aisha: monitor preview vs ledger divergence and ratecard histogram. Rollback if divergence >1%.

belinda: adding temporary console alert: preview_ledger_delta_pct > 1% per tenant. Also will notify affected tenants about possible preview changes.

dan: postmortem / action items: contract test enforcing route_tag propagation, enrichment emitting tag-propagation metric with route_version/region tags, and telemetry contract for propagation latency.

aisha: filed GH-#1829..#1832 with owners for compatibility, backfill, console alerts, and enrichment metric.

belinda: will coordinate with support for tenant comms. Keep updates here.
